notablePrerequisites:
You control a Forest.
Argothian Elder does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate a Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Vernal Bloom triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Argothian Elder.
Activate Argothian Elder by tapping it, untapping a Forest and Wirewood Lodge.
Repeat.
